_source: Minimal constants from the owner's tools/sghd_evidence.py report on the English Steam STEINS;GATE install (Thread 05, 2026-10-08). The private report itself is not committed. Only facts the sghd profile depends on are recorded here.

archives._note: USRDIR/<name>, all MPK v2.0, uncompressed entries (compression 0). Entry counts identify the build.

script_mpk._note: Startup script and system scripts (ids and names).

system_mpk._note: Complete system.mpk table of contents (id -> entry name).

audio._note: Entry name suffixes per audio archive (Ogg files; codec not yet probed).

movies._note: Loose files, not in an archive. Every file starts with 4b 42 32 6a ('KB2j', Bink 2), which FFmpeg/impacto cannot decode.

sprite_sheets._note: profiles/sghd/sprites.lua sheet -> system.mpk entry, chosen by name only. Sheet dimensions and sprite rectangles are NOT verified (need tools/sghd_census.py --assets). null = no Steam counterpart in system.mpk; the sheet is ScriptHandled (never loaded from an archive).
sprite_sheets.Title: TITLE_CHIP.DDS
